name: Svix Webhook Server Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted Rust webhook delivery server with message signing, retries, endpoint management and delivery handling; no vendor-enforced monthly webhook or endpoint quota for the open-source server.
watch_out: Requires self-operated PostgreSQL, server/worker compute, network, backups and optional Redis; Docker Compose is a development-friendly deployment, not managed hosting. Open-source server differs from hosted Svix in some features and optimizations; hosted Svix Free is a separate catalog entry.
